output.explanation: Checks that each row has both a visit_date and a received_date, and that the visit took place on or before the day the record was received. A row with either date missing fails.
fails_when: visit_date is null (missing), so a null counts as a failure, not as a skipped check
received_date is null (missing), so a null counts as a failure, not as a skipped check
visit_date is later than received_date, meaning the data was received before the visit happened
passes_when: visit_date and received_date are both present and visit_date is earlier than received_date
visit_date and received_date are both present and are the same day (the comparison is inclusive)
